chunks: A group informed me, from Abū Muḥammad Hārūn ibn Mūsā, from Abū al-ʿAbbās Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan. And Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Aḥmad ibn Ṣabīḥ, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muḥammad al-ʿArzamī, from Thuwayr ibn Yazīd, from Khālid ibn Saʿdān, from Jubayr ibn Nuqayr al-Ḥaḍramī, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Indeed, every house has a door, and indeed the door of the grave is from the direction of the feet.”

key_terms.الرِّجْلَيْنِ: the two feet; indicating the direction from which the grave is approached
key_terms.بَيْتٍ: a house; used here as an analogy for having an entrance
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker of the Prophetic teaching

ai.seo_question: From which side is the grave entered according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a Prophetic instruction concerning the grave, describing its entrance as being from the side of the feet. In context, it relates to funerary practice and the handling of the deceased at burial.
